question: What is the meaning of environmental cost indicators use phase b in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators?
data_point: environmental cost indicators use phase b
description: Environmental cost indicators use phase B in relation to sustainability are metrics used to assess the environmental impact of a product or service during its use phase. These indicators help in evaluating the sustainability performance of building materials and products by considering factors such as energy consumption, water usage, waste generation, and potential for reuse or recycling. By analyzing these indicators, stakeholders can make informed decisions to minimize environmental costs and promote sustainable practices in the construction industry.
